newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela foreign reserves rise to $13.835 billion.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela foreign reserves rise to $13.835 billion.

text.p: Venezuela's foreign reserves rose $227 million, or 1.7 percent, to $13.835 billion in the week to October 21, according to figures released by the central bank Friday.
Reserves were up from $13.608 billion on October 15, the bank's latest weekly bulletin of indicators showed.
Since the start of the year, reserve levels have risen $4.112 billion, or 42 percent.
Government officials had targeted foreign reserves to grow by $1.5 billion over the course of 1996 as part of Venezuela's IMF-supported economic adjustment program.
Venezuela's foreign reserves fell $1.784 billion, or 15.5 percent, in 1995 to end the year at $9.723 billion.
